checks.detail: Q = T3 + Y in every generation: (u, d)_L = (2/3, -1/3) [also (c, s), (t, b)], (nu, l)_L = (0, -1) [l = e, mu, tau], up-type singlets 2/3, down-type -1/3, charged-lepton singlets -1, nu_R 0
checks.name: electric_charges

checks.detail: [T3, T+] = +T+, [T3, T-] = -T-: W+ = (W1 - i W2)/sqrt2 carries Q = +1, W- = (W1 + i W2)/sqrt2 carries Q = -1 (Y(W) = 0); W- is the antiparticle of W+
checks.name: W_charges

checks.detail: A = sin(theta_W) W3 + cos(theta_W) B couples with g T3 sin + g' Y cos = e (T3 + Y), e = g g'/sqrt(g^2 + g'^2): e for e-, 2e/3 for u, -e/3 for d, 0 for nu; the W+W-gamma vertex has strength e
checks.name: photon_coupling

checks.detail: Z = cos W3 - sin B couples with sqrt(g^2 + g'^2)(T3 - Q sin^2 theta_W)
checks.name: Z_coupling

checks.detail: three generations (Q, u_R, d_R, L, e_R, nu_R) as 4D Weyl zero modes: SU(3)^2U(1) 0, SU(2)^2U(1) 0, U(1)^3 0, grav^2U(1) 0, SU(3)^3 0; 12 SU(2) doublets (even: no Witten anomaly); dirac16complex is a gauge singlet. Three lepton generations with ONE quark generation would leave SU(2)^2U(1) = -1 and U(1)^3 = 3/2: the second and third quark generations are required
checks.name: anomaly_cancellation

checks.detail: P_+ = (1 + Gamma4)/2 is a Hermitian projector
checks.name: P_plus_projector_hermitian

checks.detail: P_+ commutes with every 4D Lorentz generator gamma^a gamma^b (a, b = x1..x4)
checks.name: P_plus_lorentz_invariant

checks.detail: P_+ commutes with C gamma^mu (mu = x1..x4): Psibar gamma^mu P_+ Psi = (P_+ Psi)^dagger C gamma^mu (P_+ Psi) is the 4D vector current of the Gamma4 = +1 part
checks.name: chiral_current_is_vector

checks.detail: B commutes with every 4D Lorentz generator and with C: the halves B = -1 (Psi_A) and B = +1 (Psi_B) are 4D-Lorentz-invariant and Psibar Psi = S_A + S_B does not mix them
checks.name: B_lorentz_invariant

checks.detail: Gamma4 = i g1 g2 g3 g4 = -B gamma^(x0) as 16 x 16 matrices, [B, gamma^(x0)] = 0: P_+ = (1 - B gamma^(x0))/2, i.e. (1 + gamma^(x0))/2 on Psi_A and (1 - gamma^(x0))/2 on Psi_B, which annihilates Psi_B wherever (1 - gamma^(x0)) Psi = 0 (the regular tip)
checks.name: Gamma4_equals_minus_B_gamma0

checks.detail: in block (j, s2, s3): P_+ = (1 - B sigma3)/2, B = j s2: the a-component in Psi_A (B = -1), the b-component in Psi_B (B = +1)
checks.name: P_plus_block_form

checks.detail: the blocks that carry the Standard-Model zero modes, [[1, -1, 1], [-1, 1, 1]], have B = -1: the visible zero modes live in the B = -1 half
checks.name: sm_zero_modes_in_psiA_blocks

checks.detail: the dark-matter orbital satisfies b(-L) = 0 (regular tip): -3.6e-17
checks.name: tip_condition_b_zero

checks.detail: Z charge density u^dagger P_+ u at the tip: Psi_A fold band a0(-L)^2 = 1.629960e-01 per unit length in each of its 4 blocks, Psi_B fold band 0 exactly
checks.name: Z_charge_fold_band

checks.detail: Psi_A dark-matter states: a_DM(-L)^2 = 2.573448e-01; Psi_B dark-matter states: 0 exactly, and every transition current Psibar_A gamma^mu P_+ Psi_B and Psibar_B gamma^mu P_+ Psi_A vanishes at the tip (P_+ Psi_B = 0 there)
checks.name: Z_charge_dark_matter

checks.detail: with the three neutrinos and the Psi_A fold band of Z coupling r times the neutrino's, N_nu = 3 + 2 r^2; the PDG 2025 value N_nu = 2.9963 +- 0.0074 (Janot and Jadach 2020) is reproduced by r = 0 (pull 0.50) and bounds r^2 < 0.0056 (two standard deviations); (the superseded LEP 2006 value 2.9840 +- 0.0082 lies 1.9 standard deviations below 3)
checks.name: Z_invisible_width

checks.detail: at the Z-width bound (r^2 = 0.0056) the Psi_A fold band would decouple at 14.7 MeV, where g_s = 10.75 (photons, e+-, three neutrinos), so it would carry the neutrino temperature and add Delta N_eff = 2 (excluded: N_eff = 2.99 +- 0.17, Planck 2018); above the Z mass its production rate ~ 0.1 r^2 alpha_Z^2 T (alpha_Z = 0.0411) stays below the Hubble rate only for r^2 < 8e-13 (ESTIMATE). UM-2 therefore sets the even part of the chiral tip Z portal to zero, c_Z = 0: the Psi_A fold band, like the Psi_B fold band, is never thermalised and is not part of the CNB; the oriented part c'_Z (odd under the fold reflection) keeps the decays of the heavy odd Psi_A states
checks.name: Psi_A_decoupled_from_Z

checks.detail: with the tree-level angle of the couplings of the mass fit (sin^2 = 0.22363) instead of the MS-bar 0.23122 the total tree-level width changes by +0.82 %: a scheme ambiguity at the per-cent level
checks.name: Z_width_scheme

checks.detail: tree-level Z widths of the three generations (massless fermions, MS-bar angle): invisible (3 nu) 497.7 MeV (measured 499.1, PDG 2025), each charged lepton 83.4 MeV, hadronic 1674.4 MeV (with the QCD factor 1 + alpha_s/pi: 1737.3 MeV), total 2422.3 MeV (2485.2 MeV with the QCD factor; measured 2495.5 MeV); R_l = 20.83 (measured 20.77): the three generations reproduce the Z width to the size of the electroweak loop corrections that UM-2 does not compute; the one-generation conflict (total 1232 MeV) is gone
checks.name: Z_widths_three_generations

description: UM-2: charges, anomalies (three generations), W+- and Z, the chiral tip Z portal, the halves Psi_A and Psi_B, Z charges, Z invisible width with three neutrinos, the Psi_A Z coupling, Z widths of three generations
